{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor balancers''' were components aboard [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bikes, such as [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet's]] [[Flare-S swoop/Legends|Flare-S swoop]]. Alongside atmospheric [[Steering vane/Legends|maneuver vanes]], repulsor balancers controlled the swoop's maneuverability.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
